The first public release. agent-supervisor runs several AI coding agents in parallel on your own
machine, each in its own git worktree, and feeds failing CI, review comments, and merge conflicts
back to the same agent session, with hard limits on retries and spending. Start with the
[README](https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor#readme), and read the
[trust model](https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/trust-model.md)
before pointing it at anything important.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor/releases/download/v0.3.0/agent_supervisor-0.3.0-py3-none-any.whl
agsv serve
```

## Highlights

- **Install from a release**, with the board built in; no Node.js needed. macOS and Linux (Windows
  through WSL).
- **Settings page**: shows which agents and whether `gh` can be used, and the command to fix what
  is missing. A check that fails or hangs no longer stops the daemon.
- **Plug-in adapters**: other coding agents can be added as separate Python packages through an
  entry point. See the [adapter guide](https://github.com/ppoozine/agent-supervisor/blob/v0.3.0/docs/guide/adapters.md)
  and the example adapter, which needs no account.
- **Documentation**: a usage guide, the trust model and known limitations, the HTTP API reference,
  and contributor guidelines.
- **Fewer stuck tasks**: recovers from interruptions while preparing or archiving, notices a pull
  request reopened on GitHub, and handles an agent rewriting history it had already pushed.

## Changes that affect existing users

- **The command is now `agsv`** (was `asv`, which clashes with Airspeed Velocity).
- **Only comments from the repo's owner, organization members, and collaborators are sent to the
  agent.** Comments from anyone else are recorded but not sent.
- **Budgets count from the latest time you stepped in** (opening the task or sending a message),
  and a message is never refused because of the budget.
- All text in the board, the logs, and the code is now in English.
- The data directory (`~/.agent-supervisor`) and the database are unchanged; 0.2 data keeps working.

agent-supervisor is at 0.x: the adapter interface, the HTTP API, the config file, and the database
schema may change in any minor release.
